{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out rows with customer_age == -1 (invalid data)
valid_converted_df = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_converted_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Get counts
total_converted = len(converted_df)
valid_converted = len(valid_converted_df)

# Print results
print(f"Total converted customers: {total_converted}")
print(f"Converted customers with valid age: {valid_converted}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted}")"}
